skills.description: Analyze authorized video content from a local video file, a public direct HTTP(S) video URL, or—with --allow-platform—a single public video on a platform page (e.g. Bilibili/YouTube watch links, fetched via yt-dlp without login or cookies). Use this skill whenever the user asks to read, understand, summarize, transcribe, extract chapters or key moments from a video, or asks questions about a video’s contents—even if they refer to a video link rather than saying “video analysis.” It safely downloads direct media links, extracts audio and key frames, transcribes speech, optionally uses explicitly selected GPT, Grok, or any user-supplied OpenAI-compatible vision model (just an API key, endpoint, and model name) to interpret frames and GPT, Grok, DeepSeek, or custom text providers to synthesize a report, and produces timestamped results.
skills.description_zh: 主要用于识别给定视频链接中视频内容，最后调用工具自动完成视频中所描述任务。本skill使用ASR识别语音转文字，使用ffempeg切分视频切块，可调用外部多模态模型对切出的图片进行图片识别，识别结果与ASR结果进行二次验证，最后得出视频所描述的内容，以描述内容交付给agent后，自动完成视频中所描述任务.
skills.name: video-analysis
